facts.text: Bandits is a gym.Env whose action space is spaces.Discrete(arms) and whose observation space is None
The constructor takes arms and max_steps and asserts that both are greater than 1
sample_task supports the Classical, Uniform and Gaussian distribution settings, with default mean 0.50 and dev 0.05
set_task stores task_config as exp_gains and asserts that its shape is (K,)
reset raises an exception unless set_task set exp_gains first; a successful reset sets steps to 0 and need_reset to False
step raises unless reset was called, indexes exp_gains by the action, draws a Bernoulli reward with that expected gain, and reports steps and expected_gain in info
An episode is done when steps reaches max_steps, and a done episode requires a reset before the next step
step returns the legacy Gymnasium 4-tuple (observation, reward, done, info)
expected_upperbound returns max_steps multiplied by the largest expected gain
The module imports numpy's global random generator
step draws its Bernoulli reward from numpy's global random generator
The class body defines __init__, reset, step, sample_task, set_task and expected_upperbound, and defines no seed method
The registered bandits-v0 environment passes arms=50 and max_steps=1000

determinism.notes: Bandits draws its task and Bernoulli reward from numpy's global random generator rather than a per-environment generator; the bridge records a supplied seed, but the class's own draws are not tied to it, so a seed does not repeat a trajectory

gaps: analytic bandit model only: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator, sensor or noise model; a tick is one draw of a Bernoulli reward with the selected arm's expected gain
no wall-clock pacing: timestep_ms 0 and realtime_factor 0, so a tick does not advance simulated time
reset is partial: reset() restarts the step counter but keeps the gain table and the random stream
the fake starts with a fixed placeholder gain table because the upstream reset() raises until set_task has run; the fake also uses Python's random.Random instead of numpy's global generator
the fake implements only the methods Bandits itself defines; inherited gym.Env helpers (for example close, render and seed) are omitted
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: Bandits exposes no get_state/set_state and defines no seed method of its own

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the gain table and step counter stay readable
